Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Plans exist to upgrade the national ID to a digital ID, managed by the Ministry of Local Government, Chieftainship, Home Affairs and Police (Min of LGCHAP). The national ID currently provides identity verification for government payroll, pensioners, and private sector. Digital ID and its integration with an interoperability platform is at planning stage.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Lesotho has a Data Protection Act (2013). The Electronic Transactions and Electronic Commerce Bill (2022) and the Computer Crime and Cybersecurity Bill (2023) are pending enactment. The Digital Government Act is still being drafted. No specific cross-government data sharing legislation is yet in force.

Comments: Lesotho has a Data Protection Act (2013/2011) providing some personal data protections and an independent Data Protection Commission. No data localization requirements documented.
